title: Config
description: symify configuration — a single symify.toml / conf.d/*.toml file. Source of truth for both the Rust config types (via typify) and editor TOML validation. See knowledge/configuration.md.

settings.description: Defaults applied to every mapping (each mapping may override them).

oneOf.description: A symbolic link at the live path pointing to the real file in the store.
An independent content copy, kept up to date incrementally (only changed files are copied).

Conflict.title: Conflict
Conflict.description: What to do when the side being written already exists and differs.

oneOf.description: Leave the existing file and report the conflict (counts as drift).
Delete the existing file, then write (no backup).
Rename the existing file to `<name>.<timestamp>.bak`, then write.

LinkValue.title: LinkValue
LinkValue.description: A link entry value: "" or true mirrors the key under store; `<path>` is an explicit store path (relative to store, or absolute); false disables the entry.

oneOf.description: An explicit store path (relative to store, or absolute); "" mirrors the key under store.
true mirrors the key under store; false disables the entry.

MachineMatch.title: MachineMatch
MachineMatch.description: A machine condition: one pattern or a list of alternatives. A pattern matches case-insensitively; `*` is allowed at the start and/or end of a host pattern (e.g. "wrk-*", "*.local"), nowhere else.

oneOf.description: Alternatives; the condition matches when any pattern matches.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Defaults applied to every mapping; each mapping may override them.

store.description: Backing repository that holds the real content (e.g. "~/dotfiles").

mode.description: Default link mechanism for all mappings.

conflict.description: Default policy when the side being written already exists and differs.

backup_keep.description: Keep at most this many `<name>.<timestamp>.bak` backups per path, deleting the oldest when a new backup is written. 0 or absent = keep all (default).

Mapping.title: Mapping
Mapping.description: A named group of links, with optional per-group overrides.

live.description: Working location for this mapping (overrides settings.live).

store.description: Backing repository for this mapping (overrides settings.store).

mode.description: Link mechanism for this mapping (overrides settings.mode).

conflict.description: Conflict policy for this mapping (overrides settings.conflict).

backup_keep.description: Backup retention for this mapping (overrides settings.backup_keep). 0 = keep all.

links.description: Map of live-relative (or absolute) key -> link value.

os.description: Operating systems this mapping applies to: "linux", "macos" or "windows" (Rust's std::env::consts::OS values), matched case-insensitively with no globs. On other machines the mapping is inactive. Absent = all.

host.description: Hostnames this mapping applies to, matched case-insensitively; `*` may open and/or close a pattern ("wrk-*", "*.local"). On other machines the mapping is inactive. Absent = all.
